application.description: E-commerce channel: Flipkart Marketplace Seller API — listings v3 (price, stock, status), shipments v3 (orders, labels, dispatch, self-ship), returns and reports. Tier-1 canonical services share one contract with amazon_sp_api and shopify_admin (docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md); every other operation is a tier-2 service. OAuth2 client_credentials (Basic app id:secret, GET token, scope Seller_Api).

client_id.label: Application ID
client_id.description: Self-access: Seller Hub > Manage Profile > Developer Access. Third-party: partners.flipkart.com.

location_id.label: Location ID(s)
location_id.description: Seller location id(s), comma-separated — default for stock, order filters, cancel/dispatch and list_locations.

services.description: CANONICAL tier-1 service (identical parameters/output on amazon_sp_api, flipkart_seller, shopify_admin; contract: docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md). Flipkart Seller API: Listings v3 createListings (max 10 SKUs/call; 10 s timeout). Attaches the seller SKU to an EXISTING FSN — channel_product_id (FSN) is required; new catalogue products are created in Seller Hub. Sends product_id, price {mrp,selling_price,currency}, tax {hsn, goods_services_rate}, listing_status, fulfillment_profile NON_FBF, fulfillment {dispatch_sla 2, shipping_provider FLIPKART, procurement_type REGULAR}, locations[{id, ENABLED, inventory}]; packages, shipping_fees, address_label etc. come from attributes_json (merged last). Fails when the SKU's status is FAILURE.
